LESSON: WATER POLLUTION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: HEARING IMPAIRMENT SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Matter 2.1 Mixtures (14 Lessons) • Meaning of mixtures • Types of mixtures (hete
Topic 2.2: Water Pollution
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Water Pollution, part of Matter 2.1 Mixtures (14 Lessons) • Meaning of mixtures • Types of mixtures (hete in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five HEARING IMPAIRMENT SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY.

Key inquiry question: What are the dangers of water pollution?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Water Pollution together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and imagination: The learner comes up with new ideas in making functional water filters using locally available

materials.

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner observes safety precautions when working in a water polluted environment.

• Peace: The learner shows care by not hurting others while practising methods of water treatment.

(PCIs):

• Health Issues (preventive health): The learner carries out activities to demonstrate basic methods of water treatment.
